answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a costly, verifiable stake: every agent must lock collateral and build a public reputation atlas mapping its past work, counterparties, and dispute outcomes. Like a lotus rooted in one place, an identity cannot cheaply multiply - creating a hundred fake agents means funding a hundred stakes and histories, while honest agents accumulate trust that compounds. Attackers pay linearly per identity; defenders verify once.
